Author: Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari

 (Lakhan Kushwaha And Others Vs The State Of Madhya
 Dated : 09-01-2025
 Shri Ambuj Jain - Advocate for the appellants.
 Shri Ajay Tamrakar - Government Advocate for the respon
Heard on I.A.No.13476/2024, which is first application filed under Section 389(1) of the Code of
Criminal Procedure 1973, for suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail on behalf of appellant
No.3 - Jyoti Kushwaha and appellant No.4 - Babli Kushwaha.

entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The appellants have been convicted for the offences punishable under Section 376(3) of Ipc and
sentenced to undergo life imprisonment with fine of Rs.2,000/-, under Section 376(2)(F) of Ipc and
sentenced to undergo life imprisonment with fine of Rs.2,000/-, under Section 5(L) read with
Section 6 of Pocso Act and sentenced to undergo life imprisonment with fine of Rs.2,000/-, under
Section 5(J)(ii) read with Section 6 of Pocso Act and sentenced to undergo life imprisonment with
fine of Rs.2,000/-, under Section 506(Part-2) of Ipc and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 05 years with
fine of Rs.1,000/- and they are also convicted under Section 376(2)(N) of Ipc, with default
stipulations vide judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 10.05.2024 passed by Third
Additional Sessions Judge/Special Judge (Pocso Act) Sagar (M.P.) in S.C. No.15/2023.
Learned counsel for appellants has submitted that the appellants are innocent and have falsely been implicated in the matter.

It is further 2 CRA-6662-2024 submitted that the trial Court has not properly appreciated the oral and documentary evidence available on record and committed error in convicting the appellants for aforesaid offences.

He has also submitted that the names of appellants no.3 and 4 were not mentioned initially in the FIR and no reason was assigned for the delay in lodging the FIR and also for naming the appellants no.3 and 4 is at belated stage.
Appellants are in custody and the appeal would take considerable time to conclude.
They are ready to furnish adequate surety and shall abide by the directions and conditions, which may be imposed by this Court.
Hence, it is prayed that the application for suspension of sentence may be considered.
On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the application and prays for its rejection.

sentences.text: Heard counsel for the parties and perused the record.

Having heard the arguments and on perusal of the record, we are of the considered opinion that till disposal of this appeal, execution of jail sentence awarded to the appellants under the impugned judgment deserves to be suspended.
Therefore, without commenting on the merit of the case, the application under consideration is allowed.

It is directed that subject to depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited and on furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) each with separate surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned, the custodial sentence of the appellant No.3 - Jyoti Kushwaha and appellant No.4 - Babli Kushwaha shall remain suspended and they shall be released on bail for securing their 3 CRA-6662-2024 presence before the trial Court concerned on 09.04.2025 and on such other dates as may be fixed in this regard during pendency of this appeal.
Accordingly, the aforesaid I.A. stands allowed and disposed of.
List for final hearing in due course.
